title: React Parity Scope Classification Matrix (machine-readable authority)
authorityNote: Machine-readable authority for the React parity scope classification. The companion docs/architecture/react-parity-scope-classification-matrix.md is the human-review view and must stay consistent with this file. This is a governance tracking artefact, not a rank-1 semantic-corpus artefact, and is enforced by tools/validate-parity/validate-parity.py.

domains.behaviour_summary: Keycloak/OIDC brokering, session cookies, claim/role mapping, credential lifecycle, JWKS/discovery.
usf_proofs: make auth-proof (packages/proof/src/auth-identity-proof.ts): hermetic Keycloak token validation, identity mapping, session lifecycle, tenant handoff (28 checks, behaviour-proven)
make parity (validate-auth USF-AUTH-001..018 with planted defects)
domains.evidence: ADR 0012 (Keycloak sole IdP + local token validation, building on ADR 0010) and the auth-and-identity standard. Implemented hermetically: local Keycloak-issued OIDC/JWT verifier (iss/aud/sig/exp/nbf/alg/kid, fail-closed; rejects non-Keycloak and brokered-upstream issuers), stable actor mapping (realm+subject, never email; duplicate-email no-merge), session lifecycle (expiry/idle/revoke/logout fail-closed, value-free), identity-to-tenant handoff through the PDP (claims/roles/broker alias never grant), cross-tenant SSO with explicit memberships, value-free identity audit. Proven by make auth-proof and validate-auth. Enterprise breadth (self-service SSO, JIT, domain verification, invitations, assurance step-up, account linking, attribute mapping, live Keycloak/broker/browser flows) is DEFINED in the auth-and-identity standard and DEFERRED.
domains.retry_condition: Deferred auth/identity depth blocker completes the self-service SSO control plane runtime, JIT provisioning, domain verification (live DNS/HTTP), invitations, MFA/step-up live flow, account linking, attribute/group mapping, privileged SSO admin runtime, live Keycloak/broker/upstream integration, and browser login/callback; full auth/identity parity then moves to migrated.

Proven by make jobs-proof and validate-jobs. Enterprise breadth (versioning/replay, outbox/inbox, quotas, pause/drain, backup/restore, dry-run, live Temporal/Windmill/queue, HTTP surfaces) DEFINED in the standard and DEFERRED.
